title: Tuesday Meditation and Dharma Teaching  (We have moved to NEST RALEIGH)
description:
Please note - we are no longer at GreenDoor Vitality, the space closed and we have been lucky enough to find a new space in town. - We now meet at NEST CO-WORKING SPACE, 414 Fayetteville Street - 4th floor.  For details for the door code send an email to info@sitraleigh.com or text me at 919-306-9495. 

For our teaching this Tuesday, a continued exploration of Dukkha (unsatisfactoriness, stress or suffering), This week's teaching will stem from the Buddha's core teaching, the four Noble truths. As always, we begin with a 25-30 minute meditation and finish with the Dharma talk. All are welcome. Class by Dana (generosity). Parking is free after 6pm on the street (in legal spaces) in downtown Raleigh.
